family_directives.objective: Run all 25 objective slots unless the hard run budget or a safety failure stops the campaign. Investigate only the verified BPR and full-observed-listwise capabilities. Declare every active typed parameter, form each hypothesis from prior matched evaluation evidence, change a strict non-empty subset, and keep at least one active parameter fixed as a matched control. Adapt values from prior confidence intervals and execution-conformance diagnostics, and do not claim an implementation distinction absent from the capability contract.
family_directives.temporal_history: Run all 25 temporal-history slots unless the hard run budget or a safety failure stops the campaign. Investigate the verified strictly-past temporal-history capability. Form each hypothesis from prior matched evaluation evidence, change a strict non-empty subset of declared decay, shrinkage, residual-scale, and training-row parameters, and keep at least one active parameter fixed as a matched control. Do not vary inactive capacity or optimizer knobs.
